name: hero-dithering

frames.best_why: The blue arms of the swirl are at their widest and the whole hero, text and badges included, sits inside the frame.

tagline: Headline and button beside a pixelated blue vortex that never stops turning.
summary: A split landing hero: a big two-line headline, short paragraph, pill button and two tech badges on the left, and a circular dithering swirl on the right. The swirl keeps rotating behind a field of square dots.
appearance: On a black stage a left column stacks a large two-line white heading, a small grey paragraph, an outlined pill button and two bordered badges. The right half is a big circular vortex made of blue and black square dots, lighter along its curved arms and black at the core.
behaviour: The dotted swirl slowly rotates and its blue arms ripple while the text and controls hold still. The button and badges lift a little on hover, and on narrow screens the swirl drops to the bottom as a dimmed backdrop.
demo_content: Heading AI SDK Agents / Copy and Paste, copy about Vercel AI SDK patterns, Next.js v16 and AI SDK v6 badges.
search_phrases: dark hero with rotating dot swirl
split layout hero text and visual
pixelated spiral background for landing page
use_when: A devtool or AI product landing page wants a dramatic moving visual without a video or a full 3D scene.
avoid_when: The shader loop never stops and needs WebGL, so it drains battery, and its palette is fixed to blue on black.
customise: Set title, subtitle, description, CTA label and link, badge list and shader options through props. Layout and palette are classes and shader settings; the pixel fonts come from CSS.
weight_why: A permanent WebGL dithering shader fills half the hero and redraws every frame.

a11y.note: A hidden h1 names the section and links carry text, but the endless shader never pauses for reduced-motion users.

issues: Frame 4 cuts the swirl off at the right edge of the crop.
The paragraph is small and dim against the black stage, so it is easy to miss.
polish_why: Crisp split layout and a striking dithered swirl; body copy is small and low contrast.
